title: Amortized Inference of Multi-Modal Posteriors using Likelihood-Weighted Normalizing Flows
abstract: arXiv:2512.04954v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present a technique for posterior estimation using Normalizing Flows trained with likelihood-weighted importance sampling, the special case of neural importance sampling in which the proposal is the prior. This approach allows for the efficient inference of theoretical parameters in high-dimensional inverse problems without the need for posterior training samples. We implement the method on multi-modal benchmark tasks in 2D and 3D to check for the efficacy. A critical observation of our study is the impact of the base distribution on the modelled posteriors. We find that standard unimodal base distributions leave spurious probability \textit{bridges} between well-separated modes. We demonstrate that initializing the flow with a Gaussian Mixture Model that matches the number of target modes significantly improves reconstruction fidelity, as measured by some distance and divergence metrics. translated_title: 使用似然加权归一化流的多模态后验摊销推断
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种后验估计技术，该技术使用通过似然加权重要性采样训练的归一化流，这是神经重要性采样的特殊情况，其中提议分布即为先验分布。这种方法能够在无需后验训练样本的情况下，高效地推断高维逆问题中的理论参数。我们在二维和三维的多模态基准任务上实现了该方法以检验其有效性。本研究的一个关键观察是基础分布对建模后验的影响。我们发现，标准的单峰基础分布会在分离良好的众数之间留下虚假的概率“桥梁”。我们证明，使用与目标众数数量相匹配的高斯混合模型来初始化流，可以显著提高重建保真度（通过若干距离和散度指标来衡量）。最后，我们将该方法应用于一个精选的……
tldr: 该论文提出用似然加权重要性采样训练归一化流以高效推断多模态后验分布，并发现用与目标众数数量匹配的高斯混合模型初始化流可以消除模式间的虚假概率桥梁，从而显著提升重建保真度。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes likelihood-weighted normalizing flows for efficient multi-modal posterior inference and shows that initializing the flow with a Gaussian Mixture Model matching the number of target modes eliminates spurious probability bridges between modes and significantly improves reconstruction fidelity.
